Your first job in logistics? Let's make it an awesome one!
 

Ready to trade your schoolbooks for a job with action? At Kuehne + Nagel in Geel, we're looking for enthusiastic starters just like you. This is your chance to work in a dynamic environment where you'll never be bored.
 

 
 

Your Mission? You'll be the hero who makes sure every order gets to the right customer. How? By:
 
 

• Picking away! You'll collect orders using a scanner or a packing slip. 

• Checking quality! Making sure every product is perfect before it goes out. 

• Mastering the pallet jack! Smoothly and skillfully transporting the picked items to their destination. 

• Verifying shipping labels! A quick check to make sure everything is correct.  

It's a day full of diverse tasks, all within a team of great colleagues.
 

 
 

VG599/BUOSAP
 

 

 

• No experience? No problem! Your eagerness to learn and positive attitude are the most important things to us. We'll gladly teach you the tricks of the trade! 

• You're available to work in 2 shifts of the night shift. 

• You're a go-getter who isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves. 

• You can get to work independently. 

• You can express yourself fluently in Dutch or English. 

• You can also work in the weekends  

 
 

 
 
 

• correctly receiving, labeling and shipping goods 

• picking the goods according to your order 

• using the electric pallet truck 

• entering all the necessary data of the new products in the system 

• checking the quality of the goods 

• handling return goods in a correct way 

• counting stock

Looking for an organisational position as a warehouseman? Passionate about toys? Don't search any further!

As a warehouse worker, you start your day by going through the pickings that you pick up with the help of a scanner or picking voucher. Next up: packing the goods in the right way. 

Break time! Enjoy a fresh cup of coffee and a nice chat with your colleagues in the refectory. 

Time for work again! After a thorough quality inspection you will make sure that the picking is at the right spot and ready for shipment.

Ready to start as an orderpicker at Kuehne+Nagel? Questions?

Send an email to talent.2591@tempo-team.be or call 014 80 00 15 

Approval number: VG599/BUOSAP

- Inexperienced? No problem! Already experienced? Even better! 
 

- You will start in 2 shifts and after some weeks you will start up in the night shift
 

- Getting to work independently is not a problem.
 

- Working in a team? Sounds great! 
 

- Your language skills are awesome! English (fluent) or Dutch (basic) roll out easily
 

- When it's busy, you have to work in the weekends

• using the electric pallet truck

Are you an experienced orderpicker who speaks fluent English or Dutch and wants to work in a 2 shift system in Westerlo? At DSV you will start immediately in a modern warehouse environment where a team of logistics experts shapes the future of transport and distribution every day. The atmosphere in the department is energetic and collaborative, making you start your workday with great enthusiasm. As a specialized orderpicker in this dynamic distribution center you play a key role in the logistical process, ensuring that the cosmetic products of Estee Lauder reach their destination smoothly. The variety as a warehouse worker and logistics employee ensures that no two days are the same.
 

 
 

VG599/BUOSAP
 

 

 

• You possess a stable first experience as an orderpicker in a warehouse environment. 

• You speak and understand fluent English or Dutch to follow safety instructions accurately. 

• You are willing to work in a flexible 2 shift system with an early shift and a late shift. 

• You have no fear of heights and are willing to operate an orderpicktruck at heights up to 8 meters. 

• You are physically fit and looking for a long term fulltime job with a quick start.  

 
 
 

• You ensure the accurate scanning and sorting of various goods on pallets. 

• You pick goods based on customer orders and utilize a digital hand scanner efficiently. 

• You check incoming goods for quality and provide them with the correct labels. 

• You safely operate an orderpicktruck at heights to prepare customer orders. 

• You actively assist with the loading and unloading of trucks in the warehouse. 

• You monitor general tidiness and strictly adhere to the strict safety rules on the work floor at all times.

As an Order Picker working in our dynamic 2-shift system, you'll be right in the heart of the action, responsible for:
 
 

• Scanning and sorting goods on pallets like a logistics whiz. 

• Getting those orders prepped and ready to roll out. 

• Ensuring every item is perfectly labeled and passes our top-notch quality checks. 

• Becoming a master of the hand scanner - your essential sidekick! 

• Tackling loading and unloading tasks with confidence. 

• Conquering heights (up to 8 meters!) on our man-up equipment - it's your mission control to efficient order picking!  

Excited to jump in and make a real impact? Got questions? Don't hesitate to ask!
 

Send an email to talent.2591@tempo-team.be or call 014 80 00 15!
 

 
 

VG599/BUOSAP
 

 

Are You the Awesome orderpicker we're looking for?
 
 

• You thrive in a fast-paced job with lots of variety in a clean and safe setting. 

• You're not afraid of a bit of physical work - bring it on! 

• You're looking for a full-time gig with long-term prospects.

• Working in a 2-shift system (early/late) fits your lifestyle.

- scanning and sorting goods on pallets

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.

For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.

You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.

International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.

Functieomschrijving
 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 

• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 

• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 

• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and/or French

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

Our client is a large Belgian organization that plays a key role within an extensive and technically complex infrastructure environment. Behind the scenes, business-critical IT systems ensure that operational processes can run safely, reliably and efficiently.
As part of a broad IT digitalization program, significant investments will be made over the coming years in renewing and optimizing processes, applications and digital services. To support this transformation, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can immerse themselves in the business and help determine where and how digitalization can genuinely create value.
This is a long-term project within a stable enterprise environment, with contracts that can be renewed annually.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5  years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and/or French
